# RecvUDPMsg <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

```blitzbasic
RecvUDPMsg:Int32 udp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to receive on. |

**Returns:** The size of the message in bytes, or 0 when there was none.

## Description

Receives the next UDP message, if one has arrived, and makes it readable from the stream. It waits for up to the time set by [UDPTimeouts](UDPTimeouts), which is 0 until you set it, so it does not wait by default. [UDPMsgIP](UDPMsgIP) and [UDPMsgPort](UDPMsgPort) then say who sent it. A stream receives into one buffer of 65536 bytes (the most one UDP packet can have), and a message with more than that is dropped: the result is 0 for it, as if there was none.
